--- workflow file ---
name: Release APK

# Chaque push sur main publie une release GitHub avec l'APK (version 0.1.<numero du build>).
# Lancement manuel possible (Actions > Release APK > Run workflow) ; depuis une autre branche,
# rien n'est publie (APK disponible en artefact).
# Mesa et le runtime Linux sont construits nativement sur des runners arm64 (gratuits pour
# les depots publics), l'APK sur un runner x86_64.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  mesa:
    name: Mesa Turnip arm64
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      # Compilation mise en cache : refaite seulement si build-mesa.sh change
      - id: cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: android/runtime/out/turnip.tgz
          key: turnip-arm64-${{ hashFiles('android/runtime/build-mesa.sh') }}

      - name: Compilation de Mesa
        if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" debian:trixie sh /src/android/runtime/build-mesa.sh

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: turnip
          path: android/runtime/out/turnip.tgz
          retention-days: 1

  runtime:
    name: Runtime Linux arm64
    needs: mesa
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: turnip
          path: android/runtime/out

      - name: Construction du rootfs (Debian trixie arm64)
        run: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" debian:trixie sh /src/android/runtime/build-runtime.sh

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: rootfs
          path: |
            android/runtime/out/rootfs.tgz
            android/runtime/out/packages.txt
          retention-days: 1

  publish-runtime:
    name: Publish runtime (runtime-v1)
    needs: runtime
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: rootfs
          path: android/runtime/out

      # L'APK telecharge ce runtime a la premiere utilisation : il doit donc
      # rester un asset stable de la release "runtime-v1".
      - name: Release GitHub (runtime-v1)
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: runtime-v1
          name: Runtime Linux (Box86 + Wine 32 bits + Mesa Turnip/Zink)
          target_commitish: ${{ github.sha }}
          files: |
            android/runtime/out/rootfs.tgz
            android/runtime/out/packages.txt
          body: |
            Runtime Linux du lanceur SWAT 4
            - Box86 (traduction x86 -> ARM64)
            - Wine 32 bits 11.21 (x86) ; Box86 emule libc.so.6 lui-meme
            - Mesa Turnip + Zink (OpenGL sur Adreno via Vulkan)
            - Xvfb, xbridge (entrees tactiles via XTest), ALSA -> AudioTrack
            - Paquets Debian 13 ; licences : voir packages.txt
          generate_release_notes: false

  apk:
    name: APK
    needs: [runtime, publish-runtime]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: android
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: rootfs
          path: android/runtime/out

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      # SDK Android preinstalle sur les runners GitHub ($ANDROID_HOME)
      - name: SDK Android
        run: |
          SDKMANAGER=$(ls -d "$ANDROID_HOME"/cmdline-tools/*/bin/sdkmanager | sort -V | tail -n 1)
          yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
          "$SDKMANAGER" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0"

      - name: proot (paquets Termux)
        run: python3 runtime/prepare-proot.py

      - name: Cle de signature
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.jks"
            echo "OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE=$RUNNER_TEMP/release.jks" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            echo "::warning::Secret OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_BASE64 absent : APK signe avec une cle de debug"
          fi

      - name: Version
        run: |
          NAME="0.1.${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"
          echo "OPENSWAT4_VERSION_NAME=$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "OPENSWAT4_VERSION_CODE=$((1000 + GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER))" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RELEASE_TAG=v$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APK_NAME=SWAT4-$NAME.apk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Compilation
        env:
          OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS }}
          OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "$APK_NAME"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: apk
          path: android/${{ env.APK_NAME }}
          retention-days: 7

      # Release uniquement depuis main (une autre branche lancee a la main ne publie rien)
      - name: Release GitHub
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
          name: SWAT 4 ${{ env.OPENSWAT4_VERSION_NAME }}
          target_commitish: ${{ github.sha }}
          files: |
            android/${{ env.APK_NAME }}
            android/runtime/out/packages.txt

- name: Version
        run: |
          NAME="0.1.${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"
          echo "OPENSWAT4_VERSION_NAME=$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "OPENSWAT4_VERSION_CODE=$((1000 + GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER))" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RELEASE_TAG=v$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APK_NAME=SWAT4-$NAME-full.apk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APK_FREE_NAME=SWAT4-$NAME-free.apk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Compilation
        env:
          OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS }}
          OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-full-release.apk "$APK_NAME"
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-free-release.apk "$APK_FREE_NAME"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: apk
          path: |
            android/${{ env.APK_NAME }}
            android/${{ env.APK_FREE_NAME }}
          retention-days: 7

      # Release uniquement depuis main (une autre branche lancee a la main ne publie rien)
      - name: Release GitHub
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
          name: SWAT 4 ${{ env.OPENSWAT4_VERSION_NAME }}
          target_commitish: ${{ github.sha }}
          files: |
            android/${{ env.APK_NAME }}
            android/${{ env.APK_FREE_NAME }}
            android/runtime/out/packages.txt
          generate_release_notes: true

1: # SWAT 4 for Android — إعداد جهاز آخر
2: 
3: ## 1. النسخ (clone)
4: ```sh
5: git clone https://github.com/Sweetcoinss/swat4-android.git
6: cd swat4-android
7: ```
8: 
9: ## 2. المتطلبات على الجهاز الجديد
10: 
11: | الغرض | الأداة | ملاحظة |
12: |---|---|---|
13: | بناء الـ APK | JDK 21 (Temurin) | `java -version` يجب أن يظهر 21 |
14: | بناء الـ APK | Android SDK | `platforms;android-36`, `build-tools;36.0.0` |
15: | سكربت البناء | Python 3 | للـ `prepare-proot.py` و `ghidra2cpp.py` |
16: | سكربتات الـ runtime | Bash | على Windows: Git Bash |
17: | بناء الـ runtime (نوافذ) | Docker | في حاوية Linux arm64 (أو Linux arm64 حقيقي) |
18: 
19: ### إعداد الـ SDK على Windows
20: ```powershell
21: # مثال: C:\Android\android-sdk (نفس هذا الجهاز)
22: $env:ANDROID_HOME = "C:\Android\android-sdk"
23: $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = "C:\Android\android-sdk"
24: 
25: # أو عبر التنزيل
26: cmdline-tools\bin\sdkmanager.bat --sdk_root="C:\Android\android-sdk" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0"
27: ```
28: `C:\Android\android-sdk` هو الموجود على هذا الجهاز — انسخه إن أمكن (platforms 34…37 و build-tools موجودة) بدل إعاد التنزيل.
29: 
30: ## 3. بناء وتشغيل
31: ```sh
32: # 1. بناء الـ runtime (مرة واحدة) — Linux arm64 أو CI
33: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 -v "$PWD:/src" debian:trixie \
34:     sh /src/android/runtime/build-runtime.sh
35: 
36: # 2. إنشاء APK
37: cd android
38: .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug     # Windows
39: ./gradlew assembleDebug         # Linux/macOS
40: ```
41: الـ APK يتكوّن في: `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`
42: 
43: ## 4. على الهاتف
44: 1. ثبّت `app-debug.apk`
45: 2. انسخ مجلد اللعبة (`SWAT 4 Portable` — 1.74 GB) إلى كارت SD أو الذاكرة
46: 3. افتح التطبيق → أول مرة يدلو الـ runtime (~120 MB) ← Wi-Fi
47: 4. اختر مجلد اللعبة → التطبيق يتحقق ويحفظ المسار ويشغّل
48: 
49: ## 5. الأسرار (GitHub Secrets) — اختياري
50: للتوقيع الحقيقي للـ APK في الـ CI (بدونها: توقيع بالـ debug key):
51: `OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_BASE64` · `OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD` · `OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS` · `OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD`
52: أكثر من واحد فقط إن حابب تطرح الـ APK على Play Store.

Hmm, this is critical. Box86 works like this: when you run `box86 ./program`, box86 loads the x86 ELF and handles it via its own dynarec + a set of "wrapped" libraries (libc, libdl, libpthread, libm...) that Box86 implements itself in x86→ARM translation. Yes — Box86 bundles the x86 ld.so and libc replacements, so no x86 glibc is needed on disk. That's the standard "Box86 runs x86 binaries without x86 libraries" claim (mostly true for common libc functions).

11: # Variables fournies par l'application :
12: #   SWAT4_WIDTH, SWAT4_HEIGHT   resolution de l'ecran X virtuel
13: #   SWAT4_INPUT_PORT             port TCP du pont d'entree (cote application)
14: #   SWAT4_RENDERER               gpu (Turnip+Zink) ou software (llvmpipe)

1: # SWAT 4 for Android — unofficial launcher
2: 
3: Runs **SWAT 4** (Irrational Games / Paradox, 2005) on an ARM64 Android phone.
4: 
5: ```
6: Android app (Java)            ← APK ~3 Mo : ne contient ni le jeu ni le moteur
7:   └─ proot ─ Debian arm64 ─ Xvfb (ecran X virtuel) ─┐
8:                                                        ├─ SWAT 4 (i386 Windows)
9:                                                        │    └─ Box86 (x86 → ARM64)
10:                                                        │         └─ Wine 32 bits (wined3d → OpenGL)
11:        touch → InputBridge ─ socket ─ xbridge (XTest) ──┘
12:        audio ──────────────────► ALSA FIFO ─► AudioTrack
13: ```
14: 
15: **Au premier lancement**, l'application demande :
16: 
17: 1. sur une connexion Wi-Fi, le téléchargement du **runtime Linux** (~120 Mo,
18:    Box86 + Wine 32 bits + Mesa Turnip/Zink), conservé ensuite sur l'appareil ;
19: 2. l'endroit où se trouve votre installation de SWAT 4 (carte SD ou mémoire
20:    interne) : elle **vérifie** que `Content/System/Swat4.exe` y est présent,
21:    **enregistre le chemin**, puis **monte** ce dossier dans le runtime sans le
22:    copier.
23: 
24: C'est tout — aucun gigaoctet n'est copié, l'APK reste très petit.
25: 
26: ## Graphics: one profile per phone
27: 
28: The launcher detects the phone's GPU and picks the Vulkan driver that is
29: actually available in the runtime, then fixes the frame rate so the game runs
30: at a constant rhythm instead of fluctuating.
31: 
32: | GPU | Kernel node | Driver in the runtime | Typical resolution |
33: |---|---|---|---|
34: | Qualcomm Adreno | `/dev/kgsl-3d0` | **Turnip** (freedreno) | 720p (1080p on SD845+) |
35: | Arm Mali | `/dev/mali0` | **malisx2** (Mesa PanVK over `mali_kbase`) | 540p (720p on Mali-G57+) |
36: | anything else | — | Mesa **llvmpipe** (software) | 540p |
37: 
38: OpenGL reaches the GPU through **Zink** (OpenGL → Vulkan), the same stack for
39: both drivers. The game itself is DirectX 8.1, served by Wine's `wined3d`
40: (DXVK does not exist in 32 bits).
41: 
42: The frame rate is capped by the engine itself: Unreal Engine 2 sleeps for the
43: remaining frame budget when a frame was produced faster than
44: `MinDesiredFrameRate` (`UWindowsClient::MinDesiredFrameRate`), so the launcher
45: sets it to 30 instead of leaving the default of 35. The Android side then only
46: uploads the picture 30 times a second instead of 60.
47: 
48: Phones already known to work with these settings:
49: 
50: * **Realme C25** — Helio G70, Mali-G52 2EE → malisx2, 540p.
51: * **Samsung Galaxy A9 (2018)** — Snapdragon 660, Adreno 512 → Turnip, 720p.
52: 
53: The driver can be forced in *Settings → Graphics*; the software renderer is the
54: fallback if the GPU path fails (the launcher retries in software on its own
55: when the game crashes at start-up).
56: 
57: ## Touch controls
58: 
59: The keys are the ones the game itself uses (`Content/System/User.ini`,
60: `[Engine.Input]`):
61: 
62: | Touch | Game key | Action |
63: |---|---|---|
64: | left stick | `W` `A` `S` `D` | move / strafe |
65: | stick to the limit | `Shift` | run |
66: | drag on the right | mouse | look |
67: | **TIR** | left click | fire |
68: | **CMD** | right click | opens the game's own command interface |
69: | **ACT** | `F` | comply / interact |
70: | **RECH** | `R` | reload |
71: | **ACC** | `C` | crouch |
72: | **COURIR** | `Shift` | run |
73: | **PREND** | `G` | grab |
74: | **GAUCHE** / **DROITE** | `Q` / `E` | lean |
75: | **ARME+** | `/` | next weapon |
76: | **ZOOM** | `Z` | zoom |
77: | **LAMPE** | `V` | flashlight |
78: 
79: The command interface (orders to the team: stack up, open the door, breach…)
80: remains the game's own radial menu — it is opened with the **CMD** button and
81: then driven with the finger, exactly like a mouse.
82: 
83: ## Build
84: 
85: ```sh
86: # 1. runtime Linux (arm64) — Docker on an arm64 host or the CI
87: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 -v "$PWD:/src" debian:trixie \
88:     sh /src/android/runtime/build-runtime.sh
89: 
90: # 2. publish it as the GitHub "runtime-v1" release asset (rootfs.tgz)
91: 
92: # 3. APK
93: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
94: ```
95: 
96: GitHub Actions does all of it (`ubuntu-24.04-arm` for the runtime and the
97: `runtime-v1` release, `ubuntu-latest` for the APK).
98: 
99: ## Layout
100: 
101: ```
102: android/app/                      Java launcher (activity, input bridge, overlay)
103: android/runtime/
104:   build-runtime.sh                builds the Debian rootfs: Box86, Wine, Mesa, malisx2
105:   build-mesa.sh                   Mesa Turnip + Zink
106:   prepare-proot.py                fetches proot (Termux) for jniLibs
107:   xbridge/xbridge.c               XTest input injection
108:   rootfs-overlay/opt/ut/
109:     run-swat4.sh                  starts Xvfb, the input bridge and the game
110:     setup-wine.sh                 creates the Wine prefix, patches the game ini
111: docs/                             architecture and control mapping
112: ```

input.newString:
- name: Version
        run: |
          NAME="0.1.${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"
          echo "OPENSWAT4_VERSION_NAME=$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "OPENSWAT4_VERSION_CODE=$((1000 + GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER))" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RELEASE_TAG=v$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APK_NAME=SWAT4-$NAME.apk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Compilation
        env:
          OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEY_ALIAS }}
          OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OPENSWAT4_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
          APK=$(find app/build/outputs/apk -name '*-release.apk' | head -n 1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "Aucun APK release produit" >&2
            find app/build/outputs/apk -type f >&2 || true
            exit 1
          fi
          mv "$APK" "$APK_NAME"
          ls -la "$APK_NAME"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: apk
          path: android/${{ env.APK_NAME }}
          retention-days: 7

      # Release uniquement depuis main (une autre branche lancee a la main ne publie rien)
      - name: Release GitHub
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
          name: SWAT 4 ${{ env.OPENSWAT4_VERSION_NAME }}
          target_commitish: ${{ github.sha }}
          files: |
            android/${{ env.APK_NAME }}
            android/runtime/out/packages.txt
          generate_release_notes: true

### ليش الـ APK صغير والـ runtime كبير؟

لأن اللعبة أصلاً **Windows 32 بت**. لتشغيلها على أندرويد (ARM) احتجنا:

```
rootfs.tgz (191 MB) = لينكس صغير يحتوي:

   ├─ Xvfb         → شاشة افتراضية
   └─ xbridge      → يحوّل لمس الهاتف إلى ضغطات أزرار
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  Ecran de demarrage simplifie : une seule action utile.
  1. "اختر مجلد اللعبة"  -> le reste devient automatique
  2. le jeu demarre tout seul
  Les reglages (graphismes, langue du jeu, manette) sont dans la roue dentee.
-->
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fillViewport="true"
    android:background="#FF101418">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center_horizontal"
        android:padding="24dp">

        <ImageView
            android:layout_width="120dp"
            android:layout_height="120dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
            android:contentDescription="@string/app_name"
            android:src="@drawable/art_launcher_fanart" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
            android:text="@string/app_name"
            android:textColor="#FFFF7A1A"
            android:textSize="30sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="2dp"
            android:text="@string/app_subtitle"
            android:textColor="#FF9AA3AE"
            android:textSize="13sp" />

        <!-- Zone d'etat : ce qu'il se passe, ou ce qu'il reste a faire -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/status"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="28dp"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:lineSpacingExtra="4dp"
            android:textColor="#FFEEEEEE"
            android:textSize="15sp" />

        <ProgressBar
            android:id="@+id/progress"
            style="@android:style/Widget.Material.ProgressBar.Horizontal"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
            android:indeterminateTint="#FFFF7A1A"
            android:max="100"
            android:visibility="gone" />

        <!-- Action principale : choisir le dossier de la jeu -->
        <Button
            android:id="@+id/pick"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="22dp"
            android:minHeight="56dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_pick"
            android:textSize="16sp" />

        <!-- Lancer (apparait quand le dossier est choisi et valide) -->
        <Button
            android:id="@+id/play"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="10dp"
            android:minHeight="56dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_play"
            android:textSize="16sp"
            android:visibility="gone" />

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/restart"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="10dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_restart_game"
            android:visibility="gone" />

        <Space
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1" />

        <!-- Reglages -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/resolution"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/language"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/controller"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="@string/btn_controller"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/download"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="@string/btn_download_game"
                android:textSize="12sp" />
        </LinearLayout>
    </LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>

input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!--
  Ecran de demarrage : une carte centrale sur degrade nuit.
    1. "تحميل المحرك" (avec taille en Mo) -> barre de progression
    2. "اختر مجلد اللعبة" une fois le moteur pret
    3. "تشغيل اللعبة" une fois le jeu choisi
  Les reglages sont en bas, en boutons discrets.
-->
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fillViewport="true"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_launcher"
    android:fillColor="#00000000">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center_horizontal"
        android:padding="20dp">

        <!-- Embleme -->
        <FrameLayout
            android:layout_width="112dp"
            android:layout_height="112dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="18dp">

            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:contentDescription="@string/app_name"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_launcher_foreground" />

            <View
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:background="@drawable/emblem_glow" />
        </FrameLayout>

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="10dp"
            android:letterSpacing="0.12"
            android:text="@string/app_name"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
            android:textSize="32sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="3dp"
            android:alpha="0.6"
            android:text="@string/app_subtitle"
            android:textColor="#FFC8D2DC"
            android:textSize="12sp" />

        <!-- Carte principale -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="22dp"
            android:background="@drawable/card_panel"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:padding="18dp">

            <!-- Etat -->
            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/status"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:lineSpacingExtra="5dp"
                android:textColor="#FFE6EDF5"
                android:textSize="15sp" />

            <ProgressBar
                android:id="@+id/progress"
                style="@android:style/Widget.Material.ProgressBar.Horizontal"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
                android:indeterminateTint="#FFFF7A1A"
                android:max="100"
                android:progressTint="#FFFF7A1A"
                android:visibility="gone" />

            <!-- Telechargement du moteur -->
            <Button
                android:id="@+id/download_runtime"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="18dp"
                android:background="@drawable/btn_primary"
                android:minHeight="54dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="@string/btn_download_runtime"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/runtime_size"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="7dp"
                android:alpha="0.65"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:textColor="#FFC8D2DC"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <!-- Choix du dossier -->
            <Button
                android:id="@+id/pick"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                android:background="@drawable/btn_secondary"
                android:minHeight="54dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="@string/btn_pick"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFE6EDF5"
                android:textSize="15sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/play"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                android:background="@drawable/btn_primary"
                android:minHeight="54dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="@string/btn_play"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:visibility="gone" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/restart"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="10dp"
                android:background="@drawable/btn_secondary"
                android:minHeight="48dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="@string/btn_restart_game"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFE6EDF5"
                android:textSize="14sp"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <Space
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1" />

        <!-- Reglages -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="18dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/resolution"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/btn_secondary"
                android:minHeight="44dp"
                android:paddingStart="4dp"
                android:paddingEnd="4dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFAEBBC9"
                android:textSize="11sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/language"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/btn_secondary"
                android:minHeight="44dp"
                android:paddingStart="4dp"
                android:paddingEnd="4dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFAEBBC9"
                android:textSize="11sp"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/controller"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
            android:background="@drawable/btn_secondary"
            android:minHeight="44dp"
            android:stateListAnimator="@null"
            android:text="@string/btn_controller"
            android:textAllCaps="false"
            android:textColor="#FFAEBBC9"
            android:textSize="12sp" />
    </LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>

    New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Segoe UI', $size, $style, [System.Drawing.GraphicsUnit]::Pixel)
}

function New-RoundPath([int]$x, [int]$y, [int]$w, [int]$h, [int]$r) {
    $p = New-Object System.Drawing.Drawing2D.GraphicsPath
    $p.AddArc($x, $y, $r, $r, 180, 90)
    $p.AddArc(($x + $w - $r), $y, $r, $r, 270, 90)
    $p.AddArc(($x + $w - $r), ($y + $h - $r), $r, $r, 0, 90)
    $p.AddArc($x, ($y + $h - $r), $r, $r, 90, 90)
    $p.CloseFigure()
    return $p
}

$egp = New-Object System.Drawing.Drawing2D.GraphicsPath
$egp.AddEllipse((New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(390, 40, 300, 300)))
$eg.Path = $egp
$eg.CenterPoint = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(540, 190)
$eg.CenterColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(55, 255, 122, 26)
$eg.SurroundColors = @([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(0, 255, 122, 26))
$g.FillEllipse($eg, 390, 40, 300, 300)

$shield = New-Object System.Drawing.Drawing2D.GraphicsPath
$shield.AddPolygon(@(

    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(648, 192)), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(648, 232)),
    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(600, 278)), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(540, 300)),
    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(480, 278)), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(432, 232)),
    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(432, 192)), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(432, 108))
))
$g.FillPath((New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush ([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(255, 27, 36, 48))), $shield)
$g.DrawPath((New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ORANGE, 3)), $shield)

$cross = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ORANGE, 3)
$g.DrawEllipse($cross, 468, 12, 144, 144)
$brushOrange = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush($ORANGE)
$g.FillPolygon($brushOrange, @(
    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(540, 58)), (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(550, 80)),
    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(530, 80))))
$g.FillPolygon($brushOrange, @(

    (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(530, 300))))
$g.FillPolygon($brushOrange, @(

$g.FillPolygon($brushOrange, @(

$brushWhite = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush($WHITE)

$g.FillRectangle($brushWhite, 474, 172, 90, 18)
$g.FillRectangle($brushWhite, 484, 190, 20, 34)

$brushS = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(160, 200, 210, 220))

$brushMuted = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(170, 174, 187, 201))

$g.DrawString($S['app_name'], (New-Font 56 ([System.Drawing.FontStyle]::Bold)), $brushT,

$cardPath = New-RoundPath 40 470 ($W - 80) 760 36

=== prepare-proot.py ===
"""Telecharge proot (paquets Termux, GPL-2) et le prepare pour l'APK.

Android n'extrait de l'APK que les fichiers nommes lib*.so, et une appli ne peut executer
que les fichiers de son nativeLibraryDir. On installe donc dans jniLibs/arm64-v8a :
  libproot.so          <- bin/proot (dependance libtalloc.so.2 renommee en libtalloc.so)
  libproot-loader.so   <- libexec/proot/loader
  libtalloc.so, libandroid-shmem.so

Usage : python -I prepare-proot.py
"""
import io
import lzma
import pathlib
import tarfile
import urllib.request

REPO = "https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main/"
PACKAGES = ("proot", "libtalloc", "libandroid-shmem")
PREFIX = "data/data/com.termux/files/usr/"
OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a"


def fetch(url):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
        return r.read()


def package_files():
    index = fetch(REPO + "dists/stable/main/binary-aarch64/Packages").decode()
    found = {}
    for block in index.split("\n\n"):
        fields = dict(l.split(": ", 1) for l in block.splitlines() if ": " in l and not l.startswith(" "))
        if fields.get("Package") in PACKAGES:
            found[fields["Package"]] = fields["Filename"]
    return found


def deb_data(deb):
    """Contenu de data.tar.* d'un .deb (archive ar)."""
    assert deb[:8] == b"!<arch>\n"
    pos = 8
    while pos < len(deb):
        header = deb[pos:pos + 60]
        name = header[:16].decode().strip().rstrip("/")
        size = int(header[48:58])
        data = deb[pos + 60:pos + 60 + size]
        pos += 60 + size + (size & 1)
        if name.startswith("data.tar"):
            return tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data))
    raise ValueError("data.tar absent")


def read(tar, path):
    names = {m.name.removeprefix("./"): m for m in tar.getmembers()}
    member = names[PREFIX + path]
    while member.issym():
        member = names[str(pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name.removeprefix("./")).parent / member.linkname)]
    return tar.extractfile(member).read()


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    files = package_files()
    tars = {name: deb_data(fetch(REPO + path)) for name, path in files.items()}

    proot = read(tars["proot"], "bin/proot")
    old, new = b"libtalloc.so.2\0", b"libtalloc.so\0\0\0"
    assert proot.count(old) == 1, "reference libtalloc.so.2 introuvable"
    proot = proot.replace(old, new)

    outputs = {
        "libproot.so": proot,
        "libproot-loader.so": read(tars["proot"], "libexec/proot/loader"),
        "libtalloc.so": read(tars["libtalloc"], "lib/libtalloc.so.2"),
        "libandroid-shmem.so": read(tars["libandroid-shmem"], "lib/libandroid-shmem.so"),
    }
    for name, data in outputs.items():
        (OUT / name).write_bytes(data)
        print(f"{name}: {len(data)} octets")
    print("versions :", ", ".join(pathlib.PurePosixPath(p).name for p in files.values()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

1. **Local execution** — run commands on the phone via `su` (rooted phone) or `sh` (non-rooted).
2. **Output capture** → user copies it and pastes to me, OR the app sends it to a webhook/server.

The cleanest approach given my constraints (no server, no persistent infra):

- The user copies the output and pastes it into the chat.
- Better: add a "share" button so they can share the output to any app (including the chat).

```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│  اكتب الأمر هنا…  ls /sdcard    │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│  [تنفيذ]  [إيقاف]  [تشخيص]      │

├─────────────────────────────────┤

├─────────────────────────────────┤
│  [نسخ]        [إرسال]            │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

| الميزة | التفاصيل |
|---|---|
| **تنفيذ** | `sh -c` أو **`su -c`** إذا فعّلت خانة root (هاتفك root ✅) |
| **نسخ** | يُنسخ الناتج **تلقائياً** بعد كل أمر + زر يدوي |
| **إرسال** | يفتح قائمة المشاركة → تختار المحادثة → **يوصلني الناتج** |
| **تشخيص** | يشغّل حزمة أوامر جاهزة (الجهاز، النواة، `dmesg`، العمليات، سجل اللعبة، `logcat`) |
| **سجل** | 40 أمر سابق + Fleches haut/bas للتنقل |

### 🎯 الطريقة بيننا
1. تكتب الأمر → **تنفيذ**
2. تضغط **إرسال** → تختار المحادثة
3. يوصلني النص → **أحلّل وأصلح**

أو بأسرع: اضغط **تشخيص** → **إرسال** → توصلني كل المعلومات دفعة واحدة (وهذا يكفي أصلاً لأعرف سبب إعادة تشغيل الهاتف).
